text:
rachel: quick heads-up 1 - i'm exploring a route-aware sampling handshake we can opt-in across sdks to improve quota attribution for costly routes. want to align on fallback/console parity.

tom: header idea: versioned + hint.

```http
X-RW-Sample-Version: 3
X-Redwood-Sample-Hint: route=embed;mode=prefer
```

tom: server should accept hint and legacy flag. if hint absent, fallback to uniform; if server in hint-only logging mode, record hint but do not change sampling decision.

devrel: docs + examples needed. show how to opt in: env var REDWOOD_SAMPLING=route-aware and show runtime warning.

qa: agree on tests: py (3.9,3.11), node18, go1.21. include header-casing + proxy rewrite checks. last header-casing incident was painful.

infra-bot: incident-1822 referenced (header-casing caused lost routing attr for ~12m).

rachel: rollout proposal:
1) server "hint-only" mode (logs hints, no sampling change) for 7d to gather parity
2) sdk minor opt-in (env var) with handshake header and a clear startup log
3) tenant-level console toggle + canary (1-2 tenants) showing raw vs normalized charts
4) nightly telemetry parity job outputting both raw & normalized metrics for 14d
5) flip default in next major only after parity and docs updates

devrel: will draft changelog entry + quickstart snippets for py/ts/go. include sample code for forcing uniform when debugging: REDWOOD_SAMPLING=off

qa: also add an integration test that validates metric buckets merge correctly when both sampling modes are seen in a 1h window.

tom: console note: we must normalize bucket keys server-side so the charting layer doesn't create duplicate time series when a tenant flips. migration script for historical continuity recommended.

infra-bot: ticket created RW-9012 (sdk-sampling-handshake) and RW-9013 (telemetry-parity-job).

rachel: timeline: aim to open PRs by Thu EOD, run matrix Fri, canary Sat-Sun. ops handoff scheduled Mon after canary.

tom: i'll take compatibility review and add server acceptance tests for both old flag and new header.

devrel: thanks. i'll link PRs here when ready and add snippets to the docs site. :rocket:
